machine: MSI MPG Z390 GAMING PLUS, i5-9600K, Windows 11, driver 595.79, CUDA 12.6 cuBLAS 12.6.1
method: compute-benchmark-3060.cu (n=4096, 30 samples, 2s warmup, median, cuBLAS GemmEx tensor-op, FP32 accumulate)

locked.note: cold power-cycle, stock state, no unlock transaction

unlocked.note: USB-stick EFI transaction, plm=0x8b8f, boot=0x3ff, FINAL status=0 clean=1; device silenced (command/BAR/ROM zeroed) before bootmgfw StartImage so Windows reassigns resources

code12_fix: Windows CM_PROB_NORMAL_CONFLICT after unlock was caused by honoring UEFI-programmed BARs on the re-modeled device; GuSilenceDevice() zeroes command/BAR0/BAR1/BAR1hi/ROM via ECAM right before StartImage(bootmgfw), after all fail-closed verifications.
